requests.prompt:
Create a new production combat sprite atlas for the existing French fan RPG Mass Effect — Relay Chronicles. Use the provided crew-atlas.png ONLY as an identity and outfit reference. The target is LIARA, the blue-skinned adult ASARI WOMAN in the BOTTOM-RIGHT cell of the reference sheet (column 4, row 2, source rectangle x1152–1536/y512–1024). Do not include the other seven characters. Preserve this exact existing prototype identity, adult proportions, blue skin, sculpted swept-back asari scalp crests (NO hair), and first-game white/light-gray paneled long jacket/armor with dark navy bodysuit, belt, pale armored boots and dark gloves. Use the same soft upper-left lighting, realistic detailed prerendered 3D sprite style, fine material texture and clean silhouette. This is a derivative of that ME1-era prototype, not Liara's ME2/ME3 black Shadow Broker outfit.
Output ONE landscape 1536×1024 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the character. Exactly FOUR full-body poses of the SAME Liara, separated into a TWO-COLUMN by TWO-ROW layout, with generous completely transparent gutters and margins. Do not show labels, text, grid lines, frame borders, scenery, floor, cast shadow planes, background, checkerboard, aura, smoke or glow. No cropping of head, crest, hands, gun or boots. Each standing pose has the same body scale and fixed elevated orthographic front three-quarter game camera, facing toward screen right. Natural adult body proportions; NOT chibi, pixel art, anime, a poster or a portrait.
TOP LEFT — AIM: Liara stands braced and aims a small generic science-fiction PISTOL toward screen right in a clear steady two-handed grip. The whole pistol and both feet are visible. Keep the reference costume and the recognizable asari head silhouette.
TOP RIGHT — POWER: the same Liara extends one open hand toward screen right in a clear biotic casting gesture, the other arm held nearer her body. NO gun in this pose, no magical visual effect baked into the sprite; the engine will add effects separately.
BOTTOM LEFT — HIT: the same Liara recoils from a harmless combat impact, knees flexed and torso leaning back, one arm defensively bracing her torso. Both feet stay completely in frame; no blood, wounds, impact flash or projectile.
BOTTOM RIGHT — DOWN: the same Liara lies horizontally unconscious on her back at ground level, head and asari crest at the LEFT, boots at the RIGHT, arms resting naturally beside the body. Fully clothed same outfit, no blood. Her complete body must fit wholly in the bottom-right cell with large transparent padding, without extending into another cell. Keep natural body length and a low horizontal silhouette, not a kneeling or floating pose.
All four figures are clean cutouts. No diffuse colored halos or opacity over empty space. Preserve only natural antialiased silhouette edges and transparent emptiness everywhere else.

notes: Sortie native copiée octet pour octet ; aucun pixel modifié par script, aucun outil de détourage ou redimensionnement externe.
La disposition réellement obtenue est mesurée ; la grille régulière demandée ne sert pas directement de preuve de cadrage.
La source visuelle est un prototype préexistant, pas une validation primaire du costume ou de la géométrie originaux.
Quatre poses fixes supplémentaires ; aucun cycle animé, son, statistique ou kit complet original certifié.
